From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: NextGenOps pilot: post-call recap, proposed next steps

Sarah / Tom — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed path to a short, focused pilot so we can get to a clear go/no-go for an enterprise rollout.

Key outcomes from the call
- Problem: reduce time-to-triage for Ops incidents and route to correct on-call playbooks; current system is high-latency for contextual lookup.
- Redwood fit: model-in-the-loop routing + embeddings for KB and runbook lookup.
- Stakeholders: Sarah (Product), Tom (Head of Eng), Procurement (legal/contract).

Proposed 4-week pilot (high level) — details to follow from Marissa:
1) Week 0 (setup): access, test data ingestion, security checklist (RBAC, VPC peering).
2) Week 1-2 (integration & smoke): small corpus + endpoints, latency and correctness baseline.
3) Week 3 (metrics collection): run automated scenarios, collect success signals.
4) Week 4 (readout): exec demo + decision (go/no-go).

Immediate asks
- Can you confirm the two technical owners (ingest + infra) who will own the pilot on your side?
- Procurement contact for the SOW and contract rhythm.

Attachments we will push now: initial SOW template + success metrics workbook (draft).

I'll loop Marissa to propose owners and a draft acceptance criteria in the next email. If this looks ok, we should lock an executive readout window the week of Aug 2 so your execs can make a timely decision.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni

Hi Tom / Sarah — attaching a draft acceptance criteria workbook and an updated pilot timeline based on your owners and the Aug 9 readout.

Attachment summaries:
- poc-success-metrics.xlsx (attached) — tabs: Overview, Latency & Throughput, Relevance Tests, Data Hygiene Checks, Reporting cadence.
- Notes inside the workbook call out owners and thresholds.

Draft acceptance criteria (high level)
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 600ms for queries under baseline load.
- Relevance: top-1 accuracy >= 78% on the curated test set (50 queries representative of triage flow).
- Noise: false positive (incorrect auto-route) rate < 6% on the validation suite.
- Reliability: no more than 2 incidents impacting availability during pilot.

Pilot milestones and owners (short)
- Week 0 (Provisioning) — Aditya + Tom (infra access, VPC, credentials).
- Week 1 (Data ingestion & index) — Priya (NextGenOps) + Aditya (SE support).
- Week 2 (Integration + initial runs) — Marissa monitoring collection, Redwood telemetry enabled.
- Week 3 (Stress & metrics collection) — Redwood runs batch evaluation; share dashboard.
- Week 4 (Readout prep) — Marissa to produce executive slides; Vivek to coordinate exec slot.

Attachment: [Attachment: poc-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)]

If these look reasonable we'll move to finalize the SOW (Vivek / Aditya will push a first SOW draft).

Best,
